name: pyautogui_screen_screenshot_window
description:
Capture a screenshot of a specific X11 window by its numeric window ID and save it as a PNG.

This is the reliable method on WSLg/XWayland for capturing actual app content. Use `xdotool search --name <title>` (via the bash tool) to find a window ID first.

Returns the saved file path and image dimensions.

path.description: Output PNG path (defaults to a temp file)
